rationale: The Shared Interactive Workspace defines typed context/action/generative/review/theme contracts and deterministic capability-driven UI eligibility. It does not own candidate ranking, provider/model selection, permissions, application mutation authorization, durable lifecycle control or host-resource placement. Natural-language proposals remain bounded by existing Model Router, UAF/MCP, Security, Human Approval and Evidence authorities; therefore no new Decision Fabric decision point is required at this shared canonical layer.

project_radar_review.scope: Shared Interactive Workspace against Model Router, UAF/MCP Gateway, MMG Context IR, HRB, Security, Human Approval, Evidence and Temporal boundaries
project_radar_review.note: Any later application-specific ranking may use an already-canonical bounded decision mechanism only after deterministic eligibility and policy checks.
